title_en: Research Ethics Training for Graduate Students, Fall Semester (2nd Semester) of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: An online research ethics course for graduate students will run from 1 September to 30 September 2026 through eTL. Incoming graduate students for the 2nd semester of 2026 and enrolled students who have not completed research ethics coursework or online training should take it; BK21 participating graduate students may take it until December 2026.
applies_to: Incoming graduate students for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year, and enrolled students who have not completed a research ethics course (교과목) or the online research ethics training. The notice asks all graduate students and BK21 participating graduate students to take the course actively; BK21 participating graduate students have an extended period.

dates.what: Extended course period for BK21 participating graduate students

steps: Click 'SNUON-Course List' [SNUON-강좌목록] on the left side of the page.
Register for the course that matches your field (Humanities and Social Sciences [인문사회계] or Science and Engineering [이공계]).
Take the course (approximately 2 hours), watching 100% of all videos and viewing the learning materials.
After completing the course, print your certificate of completion [이수증] if needed.
translation:
Research Ethics Training for Graduate Students, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year

To raise awareness of research ethics among members of the university, the online training "Research Ethics for Graduate Students, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year" will be conducted as described below. Graduate students and BK21 participating graduate students are asked to take the course actively.

A. Course titles
- 2026-2) Research Ethics for Graduate Students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering) [2026-2) 대학원생을 위한 연구윤리(인문사회계/이공계)]
- 2026-2) Research ethics for graduate students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering)

B. Who should take the course
- Incoming graduate students for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year
- Enrolled students who have not completed a research ethics course or the online training

C. Course period: Tuesday 1 September 2026 to Wednesday 30 September 2026
Note: BK21 participating graduate students may take the course until December 2026.

D. How to take the course
- Go to eTL (http://etl.snu.ac.kr) → click 'SNUON-Course List' [SNUON-강좌목록] on the left → search for 'Research Ethics / ethics' [연구윤리 / ethics] → register for the course that matches your field → take the course (takes approximately 2 hours).
Note: Completion is recognised when you have watched 100% of all videos and viewed the learning materials. After completing the course, you can print a certificate of completion [이수증].

Attachments: Guide to the Research Ethics Training for Graduate Students, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year (Korean and English versions, one copy each).
- 2026 2nd-Semester Research Ethics course sign-up Guide for Graduate Students.pdf
- 2026학년도 2학기 대학원생 연구윤리 교육 수강 안내.pdf
